g.text: Hey Roathe? Do you have a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you.
Do go on. This sounds like it is going to be quite good.
I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
Wait. By the Void, are you trying to tip-toe around the news that you have another partner?
How much of a fool do you think I am? I already know, Drifter dear!
I take it you don't mind, then?
If only you could hear me laughing in the Sanctum right now. Drifter, darling. Dear sweet Drifter. I am Orokin. Of course I do not mind.
If only you could hear me laughing in the Sanctum right now. Drifter, darling. Dear sweet Drifter.
Think what you will about my society and our penchant for enjoying the company of others in a way you may see as dismissive and belittling, we also understood what it was like to love.
I knew the moment it happened. I have my methods. And no, I do not mind in the slightest. I am Orokin.
No one understood love like the Orokin. And we knew that one could have room in the heart for more than one.
I am merely disappointed that the zealots are likely too close-minded to join in the fun.
Pah. On second thought, that is likely for the best. Can you imagine the nonsense that would cause?
Well, regardless. If they make you happy, then enjoy them. But know that when you are with me?
You are mine and mine alone.
